in_hindi.name: दिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिया (Dia) is a Hindi name for a girl. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'दिया' (Diya), which means 'Given, Offered, Bestowed'. This name signifies the one who is given, offered, bestowed, or blessed.

in_marathi.name: Dia
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's beacon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dia is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Deepa’ meaning ‘lamp’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Goddess Durga, the mother goddess. The name signifies that just as a lamp illuminates the darkness, the name Dia sheds light on one's life, guiding them through the challenges of existence.
